contract: equation(<inputs>, params: np.ndarray[10]) -> np.ndarray prediction (LLM-SR contract); the ten parameters are fitted by BFGS on the training split. Score: NMSE on the in-distribution test split (OOD split also reported)
notes: Benchmark data embedded from the MIT-licensed CoEvo release; the fitting loop follows the LLM-SR/CoEvo in-loop evaluator.
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
